end.parentNote: Ishita practised showing sequence growth with rows, squares, and an L-shape of added dots. They explained that the shared corner is counted only once; after an initial mix-up, they corrected the count to 9 added dots and then 25 total dots. At home, ask them to draw a 3×3 square growing to 4×4 and label the added L-shape, including the single shared corner.
